title: Telok Ayer new bar promo
description: A newer bar in the Telok Ayer cluster is pushing weekday HH to build regulars. AC first; outdoor only after the sun drops if they have a terrace.
parking: CBD multi-storey after office hours can free up — still tighter than suburbs.
deal: Often 1-for-1 house pours or fixed-price beer until 8pm during launch weeks.

title: Riverside limited-time weekday HH
description: Selected riverside venues refresh weekday deals seasonally. Target midweek late afternoon for AC seating and the best-value boards — skip if the only offer is tourist-trap pricing.
parking: Funan / Central Mall multi-storey; weekday HH is the parking-friendly window.
deal: Confirm current 1-for-1 and free-flow soft drink bundles before you sit.
why: Only when the deal is actually good this week.

title: Near-home new F&B promo (north)
description: When a north-side restaurant or bar posts a new weekday drink deal, it lands here. Low glamour, high convenience — only listed when something fresh appears, not as a default mall loop.
when: Weekday evenings when promo is active
deal: Weekday set + drink bundles when advertised — verify this week.
why: New promo near home — not a permanent “go to the usual mall” tip.

title: Singapore Expo — live calendar check
description: Start at the official Expo events page for what’s public this week: lifestyle fairs, consumer expos, pop-culture weekends. Only go when a listing matches your curiosity — skip empty weeks.
parking: Expo car parks; event days fill — early arrival helps.
why: Calendar-driven. Empty Expo week = no card pressure.

title: Marina Bay seasonal programme
description: Only when a light show, installation, or waterfront programme is active on the Marina Bay calendar. Evening slot; duck into AC between outdoor segments.
parking: MBS / Marina Square / Suntec — pricey evenings; MRT is a valid plan B.
why: Event-specific — not a permanent skyline walk.

title: National Gallery — current special exhibition
description: Check the special exhibition currently hanging (not the permanent collection re-walk). Fully AC, high quality, and a strong midweek alternative when the heat is brutal.
when: Any day; free/discounted periods sometimes apply — check site

title: Esplanade — this week’s ticketed show
description: If there’s a concert, theatre, or free outdoor programme worth catching this week, it’s here. Check the Esplanade What’s On list before committing the drive.
when: Show times vary — buy tickets ahead for popular acts
why: Only when something is actually on the calendar.

title: Woodlands / Admiralty new F&B
description: A new restaurant or interesting menu opening close to home. Only listed when coverage or a real opening appears — never as a permanent “default mall” tip.
parking: Usually straightforward multi-storey or HDB nearby.
why: Discovery next door — the whole point of Near Home.
